# Priscilla Grant

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking maiden. She is also described as fair and golden when seen dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious student. Beneath her pale, spiritual appearance, she possesses a lively nature full of fun, mischief, and pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), forming a close friendship with her while pursuing her studies. Following her schooling, she was hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school. During a spring birthday outing, Priscilla joined [Anne](../character/anne.md) and their friends on a walk through the woods to discover [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's forgotten garden, where they enjoyed a picnic and poetic conversation. She later arranged for her aunt, the famous author Mrs. Charlotte E.

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne.md) share an intimate friendship. They enjoy outdoor outings together, including spring walks through woods and pastures to explore forgotten gardens and discuss poetry, nature, and life.

- Friend of — intimate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), +2 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) formed a close bond as fellow students and intimate friends while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. After finishing school, Priscilla was hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school, keeping her near [Anne](../character/anne.md). Priscilla also visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), on one occasion bringing famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) for dinner and a walk through the woods.

- Friend of — intimate friends and fellow students at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +1 more</sub>

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

[Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and Priscilla belong to the same close-knit circle of intimate friends formed while studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They spent time together during their studies sharing personal anxieties, discussing their upcoming commencement clothes, and contemplating their future prospects.

- Friend of — circle of intimate friends at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of the famous author Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). She acts as a companion and travel host for Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), bringing her to visit [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after an initial visit was delayed due to her aunt spraining an ankle.

- Friend of — acquaintances visiting together (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014)</sub>
